OpenFusion saved execution

Input: synthetic analytic three-sphere scene and back plane, uint16 axial depth in mm. The images, point clouds and records below come from files written by the updated headless runner. This viewer does not reconstruct a scene or recompute the recorded measurements. Historical project figures are not included.

Saved reconstruction sequence

Each frame below is a saved raycast from the runner, in file order. Playback changes the displayed image only; it does not execute OpenFusion.

Saved surface points

Drag to rotate; use the wheel to zoom. Coordinates are in millimetres. Display sampling affects only this view; the saved PLY retains all exported vertices. These are raycast surface samples, not a triangulated mesh.

Recorded output

Values below are copied from metrics.json. Surface error is distance to an analytic scene surface; same-ray range error compares visible depth along an image ray and also captures silhouette and visibility mismatches. See the full record for per-frame values and the operator chain.
